frame_hash.canonicalization: UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted keys; rows sorted by card and field_path

probability_arm.sampling: stratified eight-card SRS extension preserving the v4 five-card set, then unrestricted two-field SRS within each card
probability_arm.field_kind_allocation: unrestricted; filled/not_specified mix is accepted as realized
probability_arm.overlap_policy: no redraw; dual-arm fields are emitted once with both memberships

flagged.sampling: v4 SRS-5 followed by SRS-3 from remaining cards; equivalent SRS-8

unflagged.sampling: v4 SRS-5 followed by SRS-3 from remaining cards; equivalent SRS-8

rubric: filled: supported / supported_by_eee_only / partial / unsupported; not_specified: info_in_source yes_primary / yes_eee_only / no
